limits: Only the immutable REC41393 parent and the genuine first periodic speed endpoint after 500 actor updates (actual actor597/total42000) are compared. This is not the latest live training weight.

Only seven fixed scene types and four replicas per type, seed290929, original unscored projection; moderate +/-0.5m/s and +/-1rad/s requests only. No full-speed, terrain, stair, jump, broad stress or hardware qualification.
Request-phase metrics are fixed 5Hz trace samples; full episode and quiet-window metrics come from the original 50Hz native accumulator and must not be mixed.
Identical birth/observation/randomization fingerprints are authenticated for both candidates in each protocol; no claim of complete hidden simulator-state equivalence is made.

Repeated zero-command standing/recovery scenes across protocols reuse the same fixed births and do not create independent recovery trials. Failure/success ledgers remain per protocol; no whole-model strongest ranking or qualification is awarded.
The native first-episode failures are physical behavioral results, distinct from the successful OS/native-driver completion. No failed execution was retried.

Each protocol reused one native environment in REC41393 then speed42000_actor597 order. Equal RNG/initial fingerprints do not cover all internal solver state. The independent nominal002 review found physical-prefix differences before script/BLEND; these observations cannot uniquely establish actor forgetting. Physical-prefix differences have not been independently verified for every remaining protocol.
